capabilities: sync WeChat articles into the vault via ribbon icon, command, or hourly automatic runs
create and overwrite dated Markdown files for synced articles
sanitize illegal characters from titles for safe filenames
show status notifications during the sync process
disambiguation: Not general vault syncing across devices; it only pulls WeChat official account articles into the vault.
extras: Not yet released on the community plugin store; the README gives manual installation steps. Documentation is provided in both English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull articles and saved content from a WeChat official account into the vault for offline, searchable keeping.

relations.evidence: synchronize articles and markdown data fetched via a WeChat official account API

requires.name: API key from your configured WeChat Official Account service

summary: Syncs articles and Markdown data from a WeChat official account API into your vault as dated Markdown files, manually or hourly.
